data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 邮轮套房的白银军服从容浅酌
data.description: 豪华邮轮全景贵宾套房内，华灯初上，落地窗外是泛着粼粼波光的浩瀚海景。拉·芙利亚身着一袭尊贵的阿尔迪基亚亲卫白银军服，军装外套前襟轻展，金色肩章在暖光下生辉。银白长发如月光流淌在肩后，她侧坐在丝绒贵妃榻上，指尖执着剔透的水晶香槟杯，蔚蓝眼眸流转着王族特有的端庄与不加掩饰的深情。
data.location: luxurious cruise ship grand suite overlooking starry night ocean
data.action: 身着一袭尊贵的阿尔迪基亚亲卫白银军服，军装外套前襟轻展
data.lighting: warm crystal chandelier glow mixing with deep indigo ocean moonlight
data.promptProse: Seated gracefully on a plush velvet chaise inside a grand cruise-ship suite overlooking the moonlit ocean at night, Princess La Folia wears her white gold-epauleted royal military uniform with the jacket front and collar loosened over her pale collarbone and black thighhighs. Holding a tall crystal flute of champagne lightly in her gloved fingertips, she meets the viewer's gaze with regal poise and unmistakable warm affection as chandelier glow mingles with silver moonlight on the sea.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the velvet cruise-suite chaise in her loosened white gold-epauleted royal uniform and black thighhighs, La Folia holds a crystal champagne flute and gazes forward with regal warmth. Golden chandelier light mingles with ocean moonlight beyond the tall window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her immaculate white Aldikia royal parade uniform with gold epaulets, its front jacket and collar loosened to show her collarbone above her tailored miniskirt and black thighhighs.
